mechanism_narrative: A higher current level of the federal funds rate (FEDFUNDS) compresses equity valuations by increasing discount rates applied to future cash flows, predicting negative S&P 500 20-day forward returns regardless of regime.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are positive in more than 60% of instances with FEDFUNDS > 4.5%, or Rank IC over 3-year rolling windows remains below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: When the Consumer Price Index (CPIAUCSL) exceeds 200.0, it signals persistent inflation that triggers aggressive monetary tightening expectations, leading to negative S&P 500 20-day forward returns.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are positive in more than 60% of instances when CPIAUCSL > 200.0, or Rank IC over 3-year windows is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: Simultaneous declines in housing starts (HOUST < 1900.0) and real consumption (RSAFS < 350000.0) signal broad-based demand contraction, triggering negative S&P 500 20-day forward returns through reduced corporate revenue expectations.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are positive in more than 60% of triggered instances, or the interaction term's regression coefficient is not statistically significant (p>0.05).

mechanism_narrative: In a low unemployment regime (UNRATE < 4.0%), tight labor markets support robust corporate earnings growth and consumer spending, predicting positive S&P 500 20-day forward returns.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are negative in more than 60% of instances when UNRATE < 4.0, or the regime-specific Rank IC is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: A higher level of industrial production (INDPRO) indicates robust economic activity and corporate profitability, predicting positive S&P 500 5-day forward returns across all regimes.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day returns are negative in more than 60% of instances with INDPRO > 110.0, or Rank IC over 3-year windows is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: When monthly payroll growth (PAYEMS) falls below 135,000.0, it signals labor market weakness that reduces consumer spending and corporate earnings growth, predicting negative S&P 500 20-day forward returns.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are positive in more than 60% of instances when PAYEMS < 135000.0, or Rank IC over 3-year windows is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: When housing starts (HOUST) fall below 1900.0, it signals a contraction in the housing sector that reduces economic growth expectations, predicting negative S&P 500 60-day forward returns.
failure_condition: SPX 60-day returns are positive in more than 60% of instances when HOUST < 1900.0, or Rank IC over 3-year windows is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: A combination of high interest rates (FEDFUNDS > 4.5%) and elevated unemployment (UNRATE > 4.5%) signals stagflationary pressures that compress corporate margins and reduce equity valuations, predicting negative S&P 500 20-day forward returns.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are positive in more than 60% of instances when both conditions are met, or the interaction term's regression coefficient is not significant (p>0.05).
